purpose: Define how MathBridge assembles one teacher-facing concept card from curriculum, progression, representation, teaching, diagnostic and evidence records.
resolution_order: Load concept_intelligence_manifest.json and locate the concept profile.
Resolve China and comparison-system curriculum placement independently.
Apply grade/stage filters without forcing same-numbered-grade equivalence.
Apply China section locators when available.
Load base and extension diagnostic catalogs, then apply all diagnostic link overlays.
Resolve source IDs and source metadata for every factual claim.
Apply terminology and interface labels only after the underlying jurisdiction/evidence context is resolved.
Assemble teacher-facing sections after evidence/status checks.

teacher_facing_sections.rule: Show curriculum expectation or placement. Do not present inferred classroom practice as curriculum.
Show how the concept develops within each system. Do not imply equivalence from matching grade numbers.
State system-specific use only when evidence supports it. Otherwise present the representation as an instructional option.
Recommend moves because they fit the mathematics and evidence, not as national teaching traits.
Keep pedagogical rationale separate from curriculum requirements.
Describe possible reasoning patterns. Do not attribute them to nationality or diagnose from one answer.
Include a follow-up explanation, representation or second item before classification.
Give one practical option that fits the Chinese curriculum context. Do not frame the comparison system as inherently better.
Show the smallest set of sources needed, with section/standard locators where available.

jurisdiction_language_rules: Display Chinese placement as 中国N年级 only when an exact Chinese grade is verified; otherwise display the verified 学段.
Display England placements as 英格兰 Year N in Chinese-language output.
Display Common Core placements as 美国 Common Core Grade N in Chinese-language output.
Do not translate England Year N or Common Core Grade N into 中国N年级.
Use the terminology glossary for representations; preserve an English term in parentheses on first use when no exact Chinese curriculum term exists.

status_gates.research_required: Do not show as established fact.
status_gates.current_specifics_pending: Describe only the general function; do not claim current grade-specific PEP use.
status_gates.grade_placement_pending: Show the verified Chinese learning stage rather than inventing a grade.

diagnostic_rules: Require at least two pieces of evidence before recording a likely misconception.
Distinguish conceptual, procedural, fluency, representation and language difficulties.
For bilingual pupils, re-probe with simpler language or Chinese when wording may be the barrier.
Recheck with the same mathematical structure and different surface details.
copy_rules: Use short headings and plain explanations.
State what the teacher or pupil should do.
Avoid marketing language, slogans, hype, promotional claims and AI-style filler.
Do not use phrases such as unlock, transform, powerful insight, game-changing, revolutionary or supercharge.
Prefer concrete verbs: compare, show, explain, ask, check, represent, calculate, justify.
integrity_checks_before_render: Every concept resolves to exactly one profile.
Every representation and teaching-move ID resolves.
Every misconception and diagnostic-question ID resolves after overlays.
Every factual system-specific statement has a source or explicit pending status.
No grade equivalence is inferred from matching numbers.
No legacy PEP record is selected as current by default.
Jurisdiction labels survive translation without being converted into false grade equivalents.
